conformance.checked: the M1-09 stream files (local); they predate the M5-10 adapter and lack device.modality, decoder.causal, data.derived and language. The current adapter reaches provenance on synthetic input; rerun infer.py to get trust-ready streams.

notes: Decoder CER: greedy 0.508, beam + LM val-tuned 0.477 (pooled over trials). The trust pipeline decodes with its own beam (RETUNED, lm_weight 0.5, frame temperature): CER 0.522.
trust gate (plug-in fit): commit threshold on calibrated p_top1 0.5000 (fitted on the 437 val trials).
